died.name: Elizabeth Pierrepont, Duchess of Kingston-upon-Hull
died.last_words: I will lie down on the couch; I can sleep, and after that I shall be entirely recovered.

died.name: Theodor Körner
died.cause: final lines of the "Schwertlied", written two hours before his death in battle
died.last_words: Now let her sing and clash, / That glowing sparks may flash! / Morn wakes in nuptial pride. / Hurrah, thou iron bride! / Hurrah!

died.name: William James
died.last_words: These then are my last words to you. Be not afraid of life. Believe that life is worth living and your belief will help create the fact.

died.name: James Leo McDermott
died.cause: After the 40-year-old deputy sheriff stepped out of his car at an oil station, the vehicle began to roll forward, and he attempted to hop onto the car's running board to stop it. It carried him forward and slammed him into a hook used to hold air and water hoses, which impaled him just below the heart.

died.name: Knud Enemark Jensen
died.cause: shortly before collapsing to the pavement while competing in the 1960 Summer Olympics

died.name: Tex Avery
died.cause: to an animator while watching a baseball game, according to Chuck Jones
died.last_words: I don't know where animators go when they die, but I guess there must be a lot of them. They could probably use a good director though.
